blocks.text: Is hisse (14.4.1 se 14.4.11) mein 14.2 ki list wale gyarah pollutants ek ek kar ke bayan hain: har ek kahan se aata hai aur kya nuqsan karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun se pollutants zyada tar fuel ke na-mukammal (incomplete) jalne se bante hain?
blocks.explanation: Carbon monoxide, bina jale hydrocarbons, PAHs, VOCs aur kalikh (soot) wala particulate matter; yeh sab tab bante hain jab fuel kam oxygen mein jalta hai. Mukammal jalne se zyada tar CO₂ aur paani bante hain.

items: 14.4.1 se 14.4.11 gyarah pollutants ke sources aur asraat (effects) batate hain.
